subject: One-off discount clearance for MedFolio - deviation request
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: One-off discount clearance request for MedFolio

Neha / Marissa,

Quick summary: MedFolio (clinical research SaaS) wants a 24-month commitment. List pricing for the package we're proposing (Redwood Dedicated, 4x ded GPU nodes, enterprise observability) is $30k/mo base = $720k TCv over 24 months. They are asking for a 35% one-off discount to match a competitor procurement bid.

Why this is exceptional:
- Large strategic logo in healthcare space, potential channel reference for hospitals.
- They want a 24-month term but refuse standard annual prepay.
- Procurement insists on the 35% off list and payment net-60.

Impact (rough):
- 35% net = ~$468k net contract value (TCV).
- Our modeled margin with a 35% concession and standard onboarding credits puts gross margin below our delegated approval threshold for AEs (policy caps at 25% on deals >$250k).

Proposal from my side:
- Alternative: approve 30% discount if MedFolio agrees to a $25k onboarding fee and net-30 payment, or 35% if they sign a 12-month prepay for the first year.
- Include a 6-month SLA credit cap and restrict quantization/experimental features for the discounted term.

Attached: pricing model and redlined SOW I expect legal to accept.

Request: Need internal clearance for deviation and an approval memo to present to the customer by COB Mon 10/05. If we can get VP/CFO signoff on a conditional approval (30% with onboarding + net-30), I'll push the concession.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake | Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Thanks Jordan. Couple quick clarifying questions before this goes up chain:
1) Can you confirm TCV vs ARR split? You have $720k TCV above — is that $360k ARR (first 12 months)?
2) What are the required infra commitments (GPU hours, ingress/egress expectations) so I can run a quick cost-to-serve estimate with finance?
3) Is MedFolio close to signing a case study / reference? That helps justify concession.

I'll run a finance sensitivity on 30% vs 35% and get back by EOD Mon. Please send the signed procurement email chain and attach the customer budget doc if you have it.

Neha

Forwarding the thread and the pricing workbook. Rishi — assigning to you for formal approval / CFO sign-off. Key points for finance review:
- Baseline list: $720k TCV (24 months) / $360k ARR.
- Requested concession: 35% off list (net $468k TCV).
- Preferred approval: 30% + $25k onboarding + net-30 OR 35% if customer agrees to 12-month prepay for year 1.
- Risk: if we approve 35% + net-60 without onboarding, gross margin slips materially and sets a precedent for West Coast hospital systems.

Attachments included: MedFolio_pricing_model_v2.xlsx, MedFolio_SOW_redline.pdf

Jordan

Subject: Re: One-off discount clearance request for MedFolio - CFO conditional approval

Jordan / Neha / Marissa,

I've reviewed the workbook and the risks. Given the strategic value and the 24-month commitment, I'm willing to grant a conditional approval with the following constraints:

1) Approve up to 30% one-time discount from list pricing (applies to TCv).
2) Customer must pay a $25k onboarding fee at contract signature (can be allocated across first invoice).
3) Payment terms: net-30 required. If MedFolio insists on net-60, the approved discount drops to 20%.
4) If MedFolio will prepay year 1 at signing (12-month prepay), we can extend to 35% discount but only with a non-refundable clause for the prepay and a 24-month minimum term locked.
5) Approval is contingent on Legal accepting the redlined SOW; procurement commercial exceptions must be captured in the SOW amendment.

Please prepare a one-paragraph memo that I can sign off on and send to the customer. Include the final financials (list vs net, expected margin delta) and the required customer commitments (onboarding, payment cadence, prepay option).

Rishi Malhotra | CFO, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: One-off discount clearance for MedFolio - next steps

Amelia — good news. Our leadership has provided conditional approval. Summary of what we can offer:

- Approved: up to 30% discount off list on the 24-month package.
- Required: $25,000 onboarding fee due at signature and net-30 payment terms.
- Prepay option: if MedFolio prepays year 1 at signing, we can extend to 35% discount with a non-refundable prepay clause and 24-month minimum term locked.
- Legal: we'll need to finalize the redlined SOW and capture the onboarding fee and payment cadence. Attached the redline and the pricing model for your review.

Next steps: please confirm which option you prefer (30% + onboarding + net-30 OR 35% with year-1 prepay). Once you confirm, I'll circulate the formal memo for signature (Rishi will sign) and send the DocuSign packet for execution.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this week.

Jordan Blake
